name: Starving Arcane
summary: Archmage Modera asks you to clear rogue elementals from the City of Dalaran. A breach has unsettled the city's enchantments and defenses, and the Kirin Tor needs room to tend its wards.

sections.title: Arcane Fragments
sections.body: The breach has disturbed factotums and enchantments across Dalaran. Some of those enchantments protect the city's defenses. Fragmented arcane energy has drawn Seeking Remnants, Saturated Remnants, and Mana Echoes. They gather to fill themselves with its free-flowing magic. Archmage Modera asks you to thin their numbers while the Kirin Tor tends the wards and other incidents.

faq.q: Why are elementals gathering in Dalaran?
faq.answer: Fragmented arcane energy from the breach has drawn rogue elementals seeking to fill themselves with its free-flowing magic.

faq.q: Who asks me to clear the elementals?
faq.answer: Archmage Modera asks you to thin the elementals inside the city. She is outside Dalaran.
The breach disturbed factotums and enchantments throughout Dalaran, including some tied to the city's defenses.
Seeking Remnants, Saturated Remnants, and Mana Echoes make up the elemental throng.
